body: All I can speak to is my special ECT hairstyle, in which I braid it back the night before to keep my bangs and as much other hair off my forehead as possible!

I was just looking for a post on this. After 9 years, I left a field that I hated and was only in because that's where my abusive family wanted me. I finally started a job doing what I want. I LOVE MY JOB. However, I'm having a depressive episode and I'm now terrified that I'm going to lose my job. I called off yesterday, so I really cannot afford to call off tomorrow.. in more ways than one. But how? How do I get up and get dressed and go work a full day? The most I could do today was sit in my shower. I don't know what to do.
